name: claude-science-operator
description: Operate a local Claude Science instance through CSSwitch, a version-gated local API bridge, and GUI fallback.

interface.shortDescription: Operate Claude Science with API and GUI fallback.
interface.longDescription: Claude Science Operator lets Codex inspect and run research tasks in the locally installed Claude Science app. It uses a version-gated loopback API bridge when compatible and CSSwitch plus macOS Computer Use for startup, approvals, uploads, and fallback operation.
defaultPrompt: Run this research task in Claude Science.
Check Claude Science and list recent projects.
